drafts.label: Reply · thinking on your own should not be a luxury
drafts.body:
This line hits because it is almost true already.

We will make AI so cheap that only the rich will think on their own — unless education changes the incentive.

If the grade only rewards the polished last frame, outsourcing thinking is rational. Cheap answers + output-only assessment = cognitive offloading for everyone, not just the poor.

My take: make the scarce skill visible. Assess the path — what a student can defend without the model — and thinking on your own stops being a luxury brand.
drafts.why: Same-day high-signal one-liner on cheap AI vs owned thinking; 86 likes / ~10k views. Grounded only in his AI-so-cheap / think-on-their-own riff.
drafts.tip: Copy & open first. Soft process-assessment bridge only. Do not invent Edison biography or economics beyond the parallel he set up.

drafts.label: Reply · learning experiences not just answer videos
drafts.body:
This is the education use case I want more of.

Video models letting one person turn a vision into a learning experience that used to need a full production team — that is real access.

But the win is not only prettier content. It is when the media still forces the learner to notice, recall, and check themselves — not just watch a polished answer stream.

Student-centric means the path of understanding stays in the loop. Tools like this can scaffold that if we design for thinking, not only for the final clip.
drafts.why: Same-day AI-ed demo; 77 likes / solid bookmarks. Claims limited to video models revolutionize education + vision→prompt→learning experience once needing production team.
drafts.tip: Stay on education access + learning experience. Do not invent curriculum outcomes beyond what the post states. Soft process note only.

drafts.label: Short · cheap tools, scarce owned thinking
drafts.body:
AI is getting cheaper and better at producing learning media.

That does not automatically make people better thinkers. It makes polished answers cheaper.

The scarce skill is still owned thinking — the path you can defend without the model. Assess that, or cheap AI just scales cognitive offloading.
drafts.why: Original Venn thesis tying both replies; no fake citations.
